name: mc_sirius_b_lpqi_orm_r10000
label: Sirius B on the five-telescope LPQI network with the final instrument: R = 10 000 spectrograph on the 10 ps IMSE-LPQI array, every pair
notes: Sirius B measured by the whole LPQI network (NOT, TNG, GTC, WHT, INT): ten pairs from 409 to 1518 m, each a two-station Monte Carlo configuration at the campaign's zenith angles, combined by inverse variance. At 1.5 km the 28.5 uas white dwarf's |V|^2 drops to ~0.6 instead of 0.95 at the Pathfinder's 530 m.
Sirius A's scattered light (V -1.46 at 10 arcsec) is NOT in the model: its photons are resolved out beyond 20 m and would add to the accidentals; the field stop decides how much.

mc_sirius_b_lpqi_pathfinder with the final LPQI instrument (F. Prada 2026-10-09): every one of the 8650 channels of lambda/10 000 over 400-950 nm measures its own g2 at 10 ps; the 6.7e6 cps capture ceiling is per pixel, so the dispersed star is not readout-limited.
